card.name: Splitting, crushing or opening dosage forms
card.fires_on: Verbs about altering a tablet or capsule, such as split, crushed, opened, or crushing, in instructions on how to take it. Most often after 'must not be', 'may be', or 'by'.

modes.label: The warning against altering a tablet
modes.description: Verbs for breaking or crushing a tablet or extended-release product, in warnings or instructions to swallow whole.
modes.example: The donepezil hydrochloride 23 mg tablet should not be<< split>>, crushed, or chewed.
